registration_class: post-outcome author-designed strengthening; not prospective or held out
objective: From a complete unpartitioned typed flat FG-DUCS table and a total atomization, return a maximum-block partition for the paper's typed composition theorem or independently checkable mandatory-coupling/cut obstructions.
acceptance: producer and independently implemented consumer agree on every case
all three positive cases return the unique maximum two-block partition
every positive has more units than discovered blocks even after closing dependencies and direct nonshared action subjects, and exercises more than one partition check
each positive partition is projected to local games and an independently checked rank-sum/kappa or losing-cylinder witness whose decision agrees with direct flat re-solving
no controlled obstruction is returned as FACTORED
resource exhaustion is an error/inconclusive result and never NON_FACTORABLE
the 43-game v1 screen reports instance and ten-family denominators separately and makes zero typed-positive claims
scope_boundary: completeness is relative to the supplied finite table and declared atomization
typed dependency hyperedges and direct action subjects specify mandatory coupling but remain strictly finer than every registered positive partition
dependency-declaration completeness is an external typed-input obligation and is not inferred or proved by the checker
the procedure does not infer atoms from arbitrary LTS syntax
the v1 screen parses an opaque fixed Java serialization and is diagnostic only
all fixtures and algorithms are post-outcome author work
there is no native third-party contract, independent actor, held-out panel, or production deployment
